contentHtml:
Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana. The headlines promise a lot, but the sign-up screens can feel like a maze. I offer a local, step-by-step onboarding service around Stretton and Brisbane that turns crypto-curiosity into confident, secure ownership. I am not a financial adviser, I just make the technical side safe and painless.

Sit beside a technician and ask anything

  • Face to face. Sit next to me, ask whatever you like, and watch every step so you understand what you are doing.
  • Security first. Hardware-wallet setup, two-factor login and a proper seed-phrase backup, so there are no lost-keys nightmares later.
  • Any exchange. I walk you through Swyftx, CoinSpot, Binance AU or whichever platform you prefer, with no hidden affiliations.
  • Tax basics. I explain the record-keeping you will need come tax time and point you at the official ATO crypto pages.
  • Scam-spotting. Learn to recognise fake airdrops, rug pulls and phishing before they cost you.

Since it is all about keeping your accounts safe, a password manager and 2FA setup pairs well with this, and for wider protection see computer and network security. Please note this is technical help only, not financial advice.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
